statement: You are given an integer array nums, whose elements may be positive, negative or zero, and an integer k.
A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return the length of the longest subarray whose elements add up to exactly k, or 0 if no subarray does.
Negative values mean a longer subarray can have a smaller sum, so a sliding window does not work here; prefix sums do.

examples.explanation: The whole array adds up to -1 + 2 + 3 − 2 + 1 = 3, so the longest subarray is all 5 elements.
1 − 1 + 5 − 2 + 3 = 6, so the entire array is the answer, of length 5.
No subarray adds up to 10, so the answer is 0.
